```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

path <- here()

res_path <- file.path(dirname(path), "results", "binary")

```

```{r functions, inlcude=FALSE}
summarise_metrics <- function(data, metrics, group_vars = c("scenario", "n", "model")) {
  
  # Build the list of summary expressions dynamically
  summary_exprs <- purrr::map(metrics, \(metric) {
    list(
      mean = rlang::expr(mean(!!rlang::sym(metric), na.rm = TRUE)),
      mcse = rlang::expr(sd(!!rlang::sym(metric), na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()))
    )
  }) |>
    purrr::set_names(metrics)
  
  # Flatten into a named list: mean_<metric> and mcse_<metric>
  flat_exprs <- purrr::imap(summary_exprs, \(exprs, metric) {
    rlang::set_names(
      list(exprs$mean, exprs$mcse),
      c(paste0("mean_", metric), paste0("mcse_", metric))
    )
  }) |>
    purrr::list_flatten()
  
  data |>
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars))) |>
    dplyr::summarise(!!!flat_exprs, .groups = "drop")
}

make_metric_plots <- function(
    data,
    data_summary,
    metric,
    scenario_val,
    scenario_var    = "scenario",
    group_var       = "n",
    colour_var      = "model",
    hline           = NULL,
    metric_label    = NULL,
    group_label     = "Sample size",
    title_dist      = NULL,
    title_mean      = NULL
) {
  
  # Fall back to the metric name as the axis label if none provided
  metric_label <- metric_label %||% metric
  
  # Default titles
  title_dist <- title_dist %||% paste0(metric_label, " distribution, scenario ", scenario_val)
  title_mean <- title_mean %||% paste0("Mean ", metric_label, ", scenario ", scenario_val)
  
  mean_col <- paste0("mean_", metric)
  mcse_col <- paste0("mcse_", metric)
  
  # Filter both datasets to the requested scenario
  data_filt    <- data         |> dplyr::filter(.data[[scenario_var]] == scenario_val)
  summary_filt <- data_summary |> dplyr::filter(.data[[scenario_var]] == scenario_val)
  
  # --- Distribution plot (boxplot) ---
  dist_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    data_filt,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x      = .data[[group_var]],
      y      = .data[[metric]],
      colour = .data[[colour_var]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "transparent", outlier.shape = NA) +
    paletteer::scale_colour_paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Safe") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title_dist,
      y     = metric_label,
      x     = group_label
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  # Optionally add a horizontal reference line
  if (!is.null(hline)) {
    dist_plot <- dist_plot +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = hline, linetype = "dashed")
  }
  
  # --- Summary plot (mean + MCSE error bars) ---
  mean_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    summary_filt,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x      = .data[[group_var]],
      y      = .data[[mean_col]],
      colour = .data[[colour_var]]
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(
        ymin = .data[[mean_col]] - .data[[mcse_col]],
        ymax = .data[[mean_col]] + .data[[mcse_col]]
      ),
      position  = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    paletteer::scale_colour_paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Safe") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title_mean,
      y     = metric_label,
      x     = group_label
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  if (!is.null(hline)) {
    mean_plot <- mean_plot +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = hline, linetype = "dashed")
  }
  
  list(dist_plot = dist_plot, mean_plot = mean_plot)
}


```


```{r data, include=FALSE}

metrics <- readRDS(file.path(res_path, "bin_metrics.RDS"))

# tidy
metrics <- metrics %>%
  filter(scenario %in% c(1, 3, 8, 9)) %>%
  mutate(scenario = factor(
    case_when(scenario == 1 ~ "Null",
              scenario == 3 ~ "Simple",
              scenario == 8 ~ "Complex",
              scenario == 9 ~ "Non-linear"), levels = c("Null", "Simple", "Complex", "Non-linear")),
    n = factor(n, levels = c(100, 250, 500, 1000)),
    model = factor(
      recode(model,
             causal_forest = "Causal forest",
             dr_random_forest = "DR-RandomForest",
             dr_oracle = "DR-oracle",
             dr_semi_oracle = "DR-semi-oracle",
             dr_superlearner = "DR-SuperLearner"),
      levels = c("Causal forest", "DR-RandomForest", "DR-oracle", "DR-semi-oracle", "DR-SuperLearner")))

# summary metrics
metrics_summary <- summarise_metrics(
  data = metrics,
  metrics = c("bias", "ate_bias", "mse", "rmse", "mae", "corr", "spearman", "sign_acc", "BLP_p", "indep_cate", "indep_po")
)

```

```{r make_all_plots, include=FALSE}
all_metric_plots <- c("bias", "ate_bias", "mse", "rmse", "mae", "corr", "spearman", "sign_acc", "BLP_p", "indep_cate", "indep_po") |>
  purrr::set_names() |>
  purrr::map(\(m) make_metric_plots(
    data         = metrics,
    data_summary = metrics_summary,
    metric       = m,
    scenario_val = scen,
    hline        = 0
  ))

# Access individual plots like:
all_metric_plots$bias$dist_plot
all_metric_plots$mse$mean_plot

```
